notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Oak Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
